This is the second time that the Chinese team won the gold medal in the "Honor of Kings" event after the Hangzhou Asian Games. The Chinese team won gold again ■ "Operation Delta" officially announced that daily active users exceeded 58 million. On October 8, the "Operation Delta" project team under Tencent's Tianmei Studio Group officially announced that on the second anniversary of its launch, the number of daily active users of the game's national server has exceeded 58 million. In September last year, the game's first anniversary was officially announced to have exceeded 30 million DAU. In March this year, it was officially announced to have exceeded 50 million. en.title: Analysis of about 2 million people reveals that people with ADHD are more likely to have ``intestinal problems'' such as constipation and irritable bowel syndrome
en.summary: Attention-deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) is a developmental disorder characterized by inattention and impulsivity, and it is said that 2-4% of adults worldwide have ADHD. A study led by the University of Warwick in the UK found that people with ADHD were significantly more likely to experience gastrointestinal symptoms such as constipation, irritable bowel syndrome (IBS) and diarrhea. read more...
